def main():
    """Run finite formula fixtures only; this CLI has no model/data/runner path."""
    import argparse
    import importlib.util
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import shutil
    import sys

    import yaml  # @reuses PyYAML safe_load

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--config', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output_dir.exists() and any(args.output_dir.iterdir()):
        parser.error('--output-dir must be empty')
    config = yaml.safe_load(args.config.read_text())
    if config['budget_unit'] != 'weak_pass_labels_expected':
        raise ValueError('The CPU self-check uses the paper expected-label budget only')
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    spec_path = root / 'tests/spec/test_lb_reference.py'
    # why: all stand-in verdicts/finite fixtures stay in tests/spec, not research code.
    sys.path.insert(0, str(spec_path.parent))
    module_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lb_cpu_spec_fixtures', spec_path)
    fixtures = importlib.util.module_from_spec(module_spec)
    module_spec.loader.exec_module(fixtures)
    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (args.output_dir / 'command.txt').write_text(
        f"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES={os.environ.get('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', '')!r} "
        f"OMP_NUM_THREADS={os.environ.get('OMP_NUM_THREADS', '')} "
        f"{sys.executable} -m research.group_verification.lb_reference "
        f"--config {args.config} --output-dir {args.output_dir}\n")
    shutil.copyfile(args.config, args.output_dir / 'config.yaml')
    snapshot = args.output_dir / 'source'
    for path in [Path(__file__).resolve(), spec_path, spec_path.parent / 'oracles/lb.py']:
        target = snapshot / path.relative_to(root)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(path, target)
    runtime = dict(python=sys.version, numpy=np.__version__, yaml=yaml.__version__,
                   CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=os.environ.get('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'),
                   OMP_NUM_THREADS=os.environ.get('OMP_NUM_THREADS'),
                   actual_model_strict_queries=0, generated_tokens=0, optimizer_steps=0, gpu_hours=0)
    (args.output_dir / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(runtime, indent=2) + '\n')
    output = fixtures.self_check(config)
    (args.output_dir / 'self_check.json').write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=output['passed'], cases=[
        dict(name=c['name'], expected_cost_exact=c['expected_cost_exact'],
             enumerated_outcomes=len(c['enumerated'])) for c in output['cases']]), indent=2))
